message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on the fact: "被告人尹某在任唐河县国土资源管理局主任科员兼党委委员期间，利用职务之便，为他人谋取利益，非法收受他人现金计13.9万元据为己有". This is classic "受贿罪" (accepting bribes). Also possibly "贪污罪"? In Chinese criminal law, public officials who accept bribes are charged with "受贿罪". If they embezzle public funds, it's "贪污罪". Here it's receiving cash from others for personal use, using position to benefit others. That's bribery. So the crime is "受贿罪". Also could be "滥用职权罪"? No, that's not about receiving money. So only "受贿罪". The format: [罪名]受贿罪<eoa>.
